item.text: {"repairs":[{"key":"pro-12:words","text":"Kastrup replies that database-like semantic associations can differentiate a fundamental subjective field without spatial or causal separation, making nonspatiotemporal existential structure intelligible."},{"key":"con-11:words","text":"Oppy concedes that associative rather than causal links make Kastrup’s non-temporal structure intelligible, narrowing disagreement while leaving his broader explanatory concerns about idealism intact."}]}
